description_en: Call GetGatewayPacketStat to obtain the statistics on valid and invalid packets of a gateway
description_zh: 调用GetGatewayPacketStat获取网关有效包无效包统计
name: GetGatewayPacketStat

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page of the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call will fail.
If the <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or the </ph></props>ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The GwEUI of the gateway to query
parameters.name: gw_eui

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_millis

DownlinkInvalid.description_en: The number of invalid downlink packets

DownlinkValid.description_en: The number of valid downlink packets

UplinkInvalid.description_en: The number of invalid uplink packets
